name: Titanochampsa
sum: Titanochampsa is a large mesoeucrocodylian known from a single skull roof from the Maastrichtian Marília Formation of Brazil.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A single skull roof from the Marília Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Fachini et al. 2022
